caption:
Schengen visa bank statement: a low balance is not what gets you refused.

The officer is not looking for an impressive number. They are checking whether your funds cover the trip you described — daily requirement multiplied by trip length.

So the lever is not adding money. It is a shorter trip, or a formal sponsor. And consistency beats size: months of steady salary credits read far stronger than one large transfer last week.
